title: Internal runtime: reminder → escalation — human SLA enforcement
description: Human task with remind_after_seconds=40 and max_reminders=2. The script waits and observes: REMINDER jobs fire twice (intent.reminder webhook), then when remind_count >= max_reminders the intent is escalated to a backup contact (intent.escalated webhook). The backup human then approves.
